name: SlimeKin
source:
You want to be the very best SlimeKin Master!! don't you?! Well, what are you waiting for! find the fable slime witch, get yourself a SlimeKin egg and get ready to train!!...but wait...I think there might be something wrong with your new SlimeKin...
[From [url=https://zodiacstories.itch.io/slimekin] itch.io[/url]]
